description: Recompute the receipt hash chain and HMAC signature. valid is true when the stored receipt matches the chain and the server signature, so the record hasn't been changed since it was created. valid does not confirm who approved. The result also includes approver_confirmation: unconfirmed, confirmed, or declined. confirmed means the person with access to the contact clicked Confirm. valid is false when a row was altered. Same as GET /v1/receipts/:id/verify.
name: verify_receipt
title: Verify purchase receipt
